prompt: I'm setting up a new Angular UI library in our Nx monorepo. We use Bootstrap 5 and unigrid.css. I need a reusable form input component that supports text, email, tel, and number types with inline validation, error/success states, and a floating label. Make it accessible and mobile-first. Also set up the Storybook story for it.

assertions.text: Component uses separate .html and .scss files (templateUrl/styleUrl), never inline template/styles
Dumb component has zero injected services (no constructor DI or inject())
SCSS uses unigrid spacing tokens (--ug-spacing-*) or leading-based calc() for margins/padding
Input has minimum 44px touch target (min-height: 44px or equivalent)
Includes :focus-visible styles with visible outline (not just color change)
Uses aria-invalid and aria-describedby for error states
Animations/transitions wrapped in prefers-reduced-motion media query
SCSS uses min-width media queries (mobile-first), not max-width
Storybook stories include at least: Default, Error, Success, Disabled variants
Uses Bootstrap classes (form-floating, form-control) or unigrid-bootstrap bridge
Includes a standalone HTML mockup file demonstrating all states visually
